historical_schooling.name: Average years of education · historical (15+)
historical_schooling.definition: Mean formal schooling years in the population aged 15 and older. Published benchmarks combine reconstructions and estimates. Not the UNDP schooling series for adults aged 25+.
historical_schooling.caveat: Source uses modern 2012 reference-country geography. No match to the selected historical borders is asserted. No numeric uncertainty interval is supplied; displayed precision is not certainty.

historical_infant_mortality.name: Infant mortality · historical decade estimate
historical_infant_mortality.definition: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births, reconstructed as decade averages. A date such as 1820 refers to 1820–1829; held constant within that decade on request, not ten independently observed annual values.
historical_infant_mortality.caveat: Source uses modern 2012 reference-country geography. No match to the selected historical borders is asserted. No numeric uncertainty interval is supplied; displayed precision is not certainty.
